select split_part(market_ticker, '-', 1) series, count(*) n,
       round(avg(pnl * 100.0 / nullif(quantity, 0))::numeric, 2) c_paper,
       count(*) filter (where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from live_orders where strategy = 'Fmmsell10')) live_ordered
from paper_trades
where strategy = 'mmsell10' and created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z' and created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' and pnl is not null
group by 1 order by 2 desc
